output.reason: Several independent lines of evidence point the same way: auto-read bags show no rise, Pelion has the same Tessaly crew pool and no rise, and the late bags come through the encode desk. Together they make a strong case for the new tag stock over the handler, and the next steps are concrete. The one weak spot is the 14–16 Oct test, which compares counters with kiosks, and kiosk printer cleaning also changed on 1 Sep.
